links.outcome: Free-text extraction accuracy of LLMs versus manual reference
links.effect: Manual input accuracy for free-text forms was 99.59%, ChatGLM extraction accuracy 77.13%, and LLaMA extraction accuracy 43.86%.
links.quote: The initial manual input accuracy for free-text forms was 99.59%, the ChatGLM data extraction accuracy was 77.13%, and the LLaMA data extraction accuracy was 43.86%.

unlisted_practices: Electronic source data repository integrating LLM extraction with eCRFs and EHR to improve data extraction efficiency

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility, accuracy, and transcription time savings of using ChatGLM and LLaMA within an electronic source data repository system for retrospective real-world data extraction from EHRs.
